messages:
sam: Heads up — FinTrust (enterprise) surfaced a blocker in their SIG/CAIQ: they require customer‑managed keys (BYOK) and want us to attach their HSM for a POC. Sales is asking if we can accept a security exception for Hosted and what compensating controls we'd need. @maria @alex

maria: We can consider a formal risk acceptance instead of direct HSM attach. To proceed we'll need: 1) envelope encryption with customer wrapping keys, 2) audit log forwarding to their SIEM, 3) monthly attestation and access review, 4) tenant isolation for the POC, and 5) a signed contract addendum. Also need explicit answers on whether keys ever leave their HSM (wrap/unwrap policy).

alex: For the POC engineering plan: we can implement an envelope flow where Redwood generates the DEK and the customer's HSM provides a wrapped KEK. We won't mount or connect their HSM to our host network. Implementation options: KMIP proxy or CloudHSM-importable wrapping cert. No changes to core runtime needed, just a wrapping/unwrapping step at ingress + extended audit.

jordan: Sales note — customer expects confirmation this is acceptable by EOW and wants a quote. POC timeline requested: 2 weeks for engineering + validation. Pricing: one‑time setup fee + small monthly premium for dedicated tenant/isolation. I'll share numbers once Sec confirms controls.

maria: Confirming we can move forward with a documented risk acceptance. I'll open the exception ticket and assign reviewers. Requirements from security side:
```
- Compensating controls checklist signed by customer
- Network isolation diagram for the POC
- SIEM log forwarding config + retention agreement
- Key lifecycle and rotation policy (customer)
- Quarterly reassessment schedule
```
Please attach these to the exception request.

security-bot: Exception ticket created: EXC-2026-112 — https://confluence.internal/redwood/security-exceptions/EXC-2026-112 (placeholder link) — assigned to maria.

lisa: Legal will need a short contract addendum (BYOK + attestations). I can draft based on the checklist, will ping @jordan for the commercial language.

sam: Thanks — I'll tell FinTrust we can run the POC under a documented exception with the listed compensating controls. Jordan: pls share the setup quote so we can lock dates. Maria: send the exception ticket here when ready. :thumbsup:

maria: Added initial doc to the ticket with checklist and POC acceptance criteria. Tagging @alex for the engineering runbook.

alex: I'll put a short runbook in the ticket with the wrapping flow and CI checks for logs. ETA: 3 business days.

jordan: Great — I'll relay to FinTrust security and ask for their key wrapping policy and SIEM ingestion details.

maria: Once we have their policies and signoffs from legal and engineering, security will sign the risk acceptance. If anything changes (e.g., they insist on mounted HSM), this will be a blocker and we'll escalate.

sam: Perfect. Closing loop — everyone added to EXC-2026-112 watchers.
